scope: Official unmodified Droid 0.242.0 and Claude Code 2.1.300 / Claude Agent SDK 0.3.300; isolated non-Claude BYOK glm-5.2 at open.bigmodel.cn. No real subscription account was accessed.

factoryHooks.taskChildren: Each observed Task child received its own SessionStart marker, with no parent marker inherited in model messages.
factoryHooks.generationBinding: SessionStart writes BRIDGE_FACTORY_BINDING to the official CLAUDE_ENV_FILE; later PostToolUse/Stop/SessionEnd hooks inherited the value in a real Droid run. Later events carry this bindingToken in the admin-authenticated envelope.
factoryHooks.installedAdapter: The shipped installer and forwarder successfully registered the real session with the control broker. Normal SessionEnd left pendingToolIds empty and a factory-session-ended note.
factoryHooks.standaloneMissionCapture: INCOMPLETE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT: the older 180-second per-request probe timed out during mission-pack native writes, after accepted ProposeMission and before the first worker. This is not evidence of complete Mission success.
factoryHooks.terminalEndFeatureRun: Pending the dedicated full Mission acceptance evidence; not established by this small hook probe.

coverage: generation environment file and symlink rejection

toolCapabilityBoundary.provider: isolated GLM-5.2 through official Claude Code and SDK
toolCapabilityBoundary.guard: Official native PreToolUse denies explicit tools:[] even under bypass; normal tools-omitted request executes once. tool_choice:none uses the same guard with offline SDK regression coverage.

normalResumeWithHooks.method: Two real Droid exec invocations, second using --session-id, with installed official hooks. Both invocations emitted normal SessionEnd; the second resumed the same native Claude Code SDK checkpoint.
normalResumeWithHooks.authentication: Isolated GLM BYOK; no real Claude subscription account accessed.

normalResumeWithHooks.usageInterpretation: These are provider-message counters observed inside the Claude Code runtime, not Droid usage counters. Missing cache-creation accounting prevents an exact cache-hit ratio; these GLM results do not establish Anthropic subscription billing.
